summary: Nebius Token Factory grants $1 in trial credit upon first sign-up, valid for 30 days. Onboarding requires a billing account with a bank card and cannot be completed without it. Usage debits the balance in real time; the card is automatically charged to clear a negative balance at the start of the month or when the configured billing threshold is reached. This is a small trial credit, not a guarantee of zero-cost continued usage. Monitor usage, balance and billing settings; no fixed campaign end date is stated.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Nebius Token Factory account.
During onboarding, create a billing account — billing setup is mandatory and you cannot complete onboarding without it.
Set up the billing account with a bank card, which is required.
The $1 trial credit is applied automatically upon first sign-up and is valid for 30 days.
Monitor usage and balance: the card automatically settles a negative balance at month start or the configured billing threshold. Stop chargeable usage if you do not intend to pay beyond the trial.
